checks.runs.update.description: Update a check run via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/{check_run_id}. GitHub App only, same auth path as checks.runs.create. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via checks.runs.get. Annotations are append-only: the request never sends an annotations array, and reconcile does not replay one.

checkRunId.description: Check run ID. Reconcile observes this id via checks.runs.get.

output.description: Check run output. Annotations are not accepted; GitHub appends them and this update does not send an annotations array.

checks.runs.rerequest.title: Rerequest Check Run
checks.runs.rerequest.description: Rerequest a check run via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/{check_run_id}/rerequest. One-shot. GitHub App only, same auth path as checks.runs.create. No EffectPolicy.

checks.suites.get.title: Get Check Suite
checks.suites.get.description: Retrieve a check suite via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-suites/{check_suite_id}. Same auth path as checks.runs.get. Returns the official rerequestable field.

rerequestable.description: True only when the check suite payload has rerequestable set to true.

checks.suites.rerequest.title: Rerequest Check Suite
checks.suites.rerequest.description: Rerequest a check suite via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-suites/{check_suite_id}/rerequest. One-shot. GitHub App only, same auth path as checks.runs.create. Calls checks.suites.get first and POSTs only when the official rerequestable field is true. No EffectPolicy.

pull_requests.review_comments.get.title: Get Pull Request Review Comment
pull_requests.review_comments.get.description: Get a review comment via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/comments/{comment_id}.

pull_requests.reviews.comments.list.title: List Review Comments for a Review
pull_requests.reviews.comments.list.description: List comments on a pull request review via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews/{review_id}/comments.

issues.comments.get.title: Get Issue Comment
issues.comments.get.description: Get an issue comment via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{comment_id}.

issues.labels.list.title: List Issue Labels
issues.labels.list.description: List labels on an issue via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/labels.

commits.comments.get.title: Get Commit Comment
commits.comments.get.description: Get a commit comment via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/comments/{comment_id}.

actions.variables.get.title: Get Actions Variable
actions.variables.get.description: Get a repository Actions variable via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}. Repository scope uses owner and repo. This is a variable, not a secret.

actions.variables.create.title: Create Actions Variable
actions.variables.create.description: Create a repository Actions variable via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables. EffectPolicy Idempotent on name: GET actions.variables.get first and skip POST when the name already exists (a POST of an existing name is 422). Not Reconcile. This is a variable, not a secret.

created.description: False when the name already existed and POST was skipped.

actions.variables.update.title: Update Actions Variable
actions.variables.update.description: Update a repository Actions variable via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.variables.get. The body name stays the path name so the same input satisfies the observe call. This is a variable, not a secret.

name.description: Actions variable name. Reconcile observes this name via actions.variables.get.

actions.variables.delete.title: Delete Actions Variable
actions.variables.delete.description: Delete a repository Actions variable via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. This is a variable, not a secret.

actions.workflows.runs.list.title: List Workflow Runs
actions.workflows.runs.list.description: List workflow runs for one workflow via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs. workflow_id may be the workflow file name (for example ci.yml), not only a numeric id. This is a separate op from actions.runs.list.

workflowId.description: Workflow id or workflow file name (for example ci.yml).

branch.description: Filter by branch name.

actions.caches.list.title: List Actions Caches
actions.caches.list.description: List GitHub Actions caches via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/caches. Supports key and ref query filters.

ref.description: Full Git ref filter, for example refs/heads/main.

actions.caches.delete.title: Delete Actions Cache
actions.caches.delete.description: Delete an Actions cache by id via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/caches/{cache_id}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. There is no get-by-id. Reconcile observes via actions.caches.list.

actions.caches.delete_by_key.title: Delete Actions Caches by Key
actions.caches.delete_by_key.description: Delete Actions caches by key via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/caches?key={key} with optional ref. EffectPolicy Idempotent. Reconcile observes via actions.caches.list filtered by the same key and, when sent, the same ref.

ref.description: Optional full Git ref. When set, only caches for this ref are deleted and the list observe uses the same ref.

actions.runs.delete.title: Delete Workflow Run
actions.runs.delete.description: Delete a workflow run via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. Reconcile observes via actions.runs.get. Deleting a run also deletes that run's artifacts.

actions.jobs.rerun.title: Rerun Workflow Job
actions.jobs.rerun.description: Rerun a workflow job via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs/{job_id}/rerun. One-shot. No EffectPolicy and no reconcile. The handler pre-checks GET actions.jobs.get for status before POST. That read is not a retry key and not desired state. The first call returns 201. A repeat returns 403, which is not success and is not retried. Not actions.runs.rerun or actions.runs.rerun_failed.

actions.runs.approve.title: Approve Workflow Run
actions.runs.approve.description: Approve a workflow run from a public fork via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/approve. One-shot. No EffectPolicy and no reconcile. The handler pre-checks GET actions.runs.get for status before POST. That read is not a retry key and not desired state. Not actions.runs.pending_deployments.review.

repos.rule_suites.list.title: List Rule Suites
repos.rule_suites.list.description: List repository rule suites via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/rule-suites.

repos.rule_suites.get.title: Get Rule Suite
repos.rule_suites.get.description: Get a repository rule suite via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/rule-suites/{rule_suite_id}.

repos.rulesets.get.title: Get Repository Ruleset
repos.rulesets.get.description: Get a repository ruleset via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/{ruleset_id}. Read only. No ruleset create, update, or delete.

commits.pulls.list.title: List Pull Requests for Commit
commits.pulls.list.description: List pull requests associated with a commit via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{commit_sha}/pulls.

commits.branches_where_head.list.title: List Branches Where Head
commits.branches_where_head.list.description: List branches where the given commit is the head via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{commit_sha}/branches-where-head.

git.commits.get.title: Get Git Commit
git.commits.get.description: Get a Git database commit object via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits/{commit_sha}. This is the git commit object, not commits.get (the REST commit).

actions.environment_variables.list.title: List Environment Variables
actions.environment_variables.list.description: List Actions environment variables via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables. The environment name is URL-encoded. This is a variable, not a secret.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded on the path (slashes become %2F).

actions.environment_variables.get.title: Get Environment Variable
actions.environment_variables.get.description: Get an Actions environment variable via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables/{name}. Observe target for environment variable writes. The environment name and variable name are URL-encoded. This is a variable, not a secret.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded on the path (slashes become %2F).

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

actions.environment_variables.create.title: Create Environment Variable
actions.environment_variables.create.description: Create an Actions environment variable via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables. EffectPolicy Idempotent projects id (the variable name) from the primary response and observes via actions.environment_variables.get. Handler GETs first and skips POST when the name already exists. POST does not change an existing value. The effect type is Idempotent, not Reconcile. Body is name and value. This is a variable, not a secret.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded on the path (slashes become %2F).

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

value.description: Actions variable value. This is a variable, not a secret.

created.description: False when the name already existed and POST was skipped.

id.description: Variable name projected for Idempotent observe.

actions.environment_variables.update.title: Update Environment Variable
actions.environment_variables.update.description: Update an Actions environment variable via PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables/{name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.environment_variables.get. Input already carries owner, repo, environment_name, and name; the runner does not inject an id. Body name stays the path name. This is a variable, not a secret.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded on the path (slashes become %2F).

name.description: Actions variable name. Reconcile observes this name via actions.environment_variables.get.

value.description: Actions variable value. This is a variable, not a secret.

actions.environment_variables.delete.title: Delete Environment Variable
actions.environment_variables.delete.description: Delete an Actions environment variable via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables/{name}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. The reconcile field is omitted: a registry observe after a 204 would GET the removed name and 404, so a good delete would look failed. Handler GETs first and returns already-gone without DELETE when the name is absent. A 404 from DELETE itself is an upstream error, not success. This is a variable, not a secret.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded on the path (slashes become %2F).

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

id.description: Variable name returned by the handler. Idempotency is the pre-DELETE GET, not a post-delete observe.

actions.org_variables.list_for_repo.title: List Repository Organization Variables
actions.org_variables.list_for_repo.description: List organization Actions variables shared with a repository via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/organization-variables. This is not the org-wide list. Response variables include value and omit visibility. This is a variable, not a secret.

actions.org_variables.list.title: List Organization Variables
actions.org_variables.list.description: List organization Actions variables via GET /orgs/{org}/actions/variables. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope. Response includes visibility and selected_repositories_url. This is a variable, not a secret.

org.description: Organization login. Not case sensitive. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope.

visibility.description: Repository visibility for this organization variable.

selectedRepositoriesUrl.description: GitHub selected_repositories_url. The response does not include selected_repository_ids.

actions.org_variables.get.title: Get Organization Variable
actions.org_variables.get.description: Get an organization Actions variable via GET /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{name}. Observe target for organization variable writes. Response includes visibility and selected_repositories_url, not selected_repository_ids. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope. This is a variable, not a secret.

org.description: Organization login. Not case sensitive. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope.

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

visibility.description: Repository visibility for this organization variable.

selectedRepositoriesUrl.description: GitHub selected_repositories_url. The response does not include selected_repository_ids.

actions.org_variables.create.title: Create Organization Variable
actions.org_variables.create.description: Create an organization Actions variable via POST /orgs/{org}/actions/variables. EffectPolicy Idempotent projects id (the variable name) from the primary response and observes via actions.org_variables.get. Handler GETs first and skips POST when the name already exists (HTTP 200). POST does not change an existing value. The effect type is Idempotent, not Reconcile. Body requires name, value, and visibility. selected_repository_ids is included only when visibility is selected. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope. This is a variable, not a secret.

org.description: Organization login. Not case sensitive. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope.

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

value.description: Actions variable value. This is a variable, not a secret.

visibility.description: Who can use the variable: all, private, or selected.

selected_repository_ids.description: Repository ids. Sent only when visibility is selected. Required in that case.

visibility.description: Repository visibility for this organization variable.

selectedRepositoriesUrl.description: GitHub selected_repositories_url. The response does not include selected_repository_ids.

created.description: False when the name already existed and POST was skipped.

id.description: Variable name projected for Idempotent observe.

actions.org_variables.update.title: Update Organization Variable
actions.org_variables.update.description: Update an organization Actions variable via PATCH /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{path name}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.org_variables.get. The input field name is the name that exists after the PATCH, and that is the observe key. Optional current_name is the name that exists before the PATCH. When current_name is set, the path is current_name and the body sends name as the new name. When current_name is omitted, the path is name and the body does not send name. Body also includes value and visibility. selected_repository_ids is included only when visibility is selected. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope. This is a variable, not a secret.

org.description: Organization login. Not case sensitive. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope.

name.description: Name that exists after the PATCH. Reconcile observes this name via actions.org_variables.get. It is not the pre-patch name.

current_name.description: Optional name that exists before the PATCH. When set, the request path uses this name and the body sends name as the new name. When omitted, the path uses name and the body does not send a name.

value.description: Actions variable value. This is a variable, not a secret.

visibility.description: Who can use the variable: all, private, or selected.

selected_repository_ids.description: Repository ids. Sent only when visibility is selected. Required in that case.

name.description: Post-patch variable name. Reconcile observes this name via actions.org_variables.get.

actions.org_variables.delete.title: Delete Organization Variable
actions.org_variables.delete.description: Delete an organization Actions variable via DELETE /orgs/{org}/actions/variables/{name}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. The reconcile field is omitted: a registry observe after a 204 would GET the removed name and 404, so a good delete would look failed. Handler GETs first and returns already-gone without DELETE when the name is absent. A 404 from DELETE itself is an upstream error, not success. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope. This is a variable, not a secret.

org.description: Organization login. Not case sensitive. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the admin:org scope.

name.description: Actions variable name. URL-encoded on the path.

id.description: Variable name returned by the handler. Idempotency is the pre-DELETE GET, not a post-delete observe.

actions.permissions.workflow.get.title: Get Default Workflow Permissions
actions.permissions.workflow.get.description: Get default workflow permissions via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow. Read only. No effect meta.

actions.permissions.workflow.set.title: Set Default Workflow Permissions
actions.permissions.workflow.set.description: Set default workflow permissions via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/workflow. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.permissions.workflow.get. HTTP 409 means the organization blocked the change and state did not move. 409 is not success.

can_approve_pull_request_reviews.description: Whether the GITHUB_TOKEN can approve pull request reviews.

actions.permissions.get.title: Get Actions Permissions
actions.permissions.get.description: Get Actions permissions via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions. Read only. No effect meta. allowed_actions is all, local_only, or selected.

actions.permissions.set.title: Set Actions Permissions
actions.permissions.set.description: Set Actions permissions via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.permissions.get. allowed_actions is required. allowed_actions=selected is what actions.permissions.selected_actions.set requires.

allowed_actions.description: Which actions may run. Required when enabled is true.

actions.permissions.selected_actions.get.title: Get Selected Actions
actions.permissions.selected_actions.get.description: Get the allowed-actions allowlist via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/selected-actions. Read only. No effect meta. Only meaningful when allowed_actions is selected.

actions.permissions.selected_actions.set.title: Set Selected Actions
actions.permissions.selected_actions.set.description: Set the allowed-actions allowlist via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/selected-actions. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via actions.permissions.selected_actions.get. Requires allowed_actions=selected, which actions.permissions.set in this slice can establish. A 409 means state did not move and is not success.

deployments.branch_policies.list.title: List Deployment Branch Policies
deployments.branch_policies.list.description: List deployment branch policies via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies. Read only. environment_name is URL-encoded.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded in the path.

deployments.branch_policies.get.title: Get Deployment Branch Policy
deployments.branch_policies.get.description: Get one deployment branch policy via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies/{branch_policy_id}. Read only. environment_name is URL-encoded.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded in the path.

deployments.branch_policies.create.title: Create Deployment Branch Policy
deployments.branch_policies.create.description: Create a deployment branch policy via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies. EffectPolicy Idempotent on the name pattern and observes via deployments.branch_policies.list. The effect type is Idempotent, not Reconcile. 200 creates the policy. 303 means the name pattern already exists: success, and the handler does not POST again. 404 (environment missing or custom policies off) is upstream and stops. environment_name is URL-encoded.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded in the path.

type.description: Whether name is a branch or tag pattern.

deployments.branch_policies.update.title: Update Deployment Branch Policy
deployments.branch_policies.update.description: Update a deployment branch policy via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies/{branch_policy_id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via deployments.branch_policies.get. Input already carries owner, repo, environment_name, and branch_policy_id. environment_name is URL-encoded.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded in the path.

branch_policy_id.description: Deployment branch policy id. Shared with deployments.branch_policies.get.

type.description: Whether name is a branch or tag pattern.

deployments.branch_policies.delete.title: Delete Deployment Branch Policy
deployments.branch_policies.delete.description: Delete a deployment branch policy via DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment-branch-policies/{branch_policy_id}. EffectPolicy Idempotent. The reconcile field is omitted: a registry observe via deployments.branch_policies.get after a 204 would 404, so a good delete would look failed. Handler GETs first and returns already-gone without DELETE when the policy is absent. A 404 from DELETE itself is an upstream error, not success. environment_name is URL-encoded.

environment_name.description: Environment name. URL-encoded in the path.

repos.merge_upstream.title: Sync Fork Branch With Upstream
repos.merge_upstream.description: Sync a fork branch with its upstream via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/merge-upstream. One-shot: no EffectPolicy. 200 is synced, 409 is a merge conflict and does not converge, 422 is any other failure. Do not retry 409 as success. The handler reads the branch tip via branches.get after 200. That read is not a retry key. This op is grouped with branches, not forks.

branch.description: Branch which should be updated to match upstream.

sha.description: Tip SHA from the handler's branches.get read. Not a retry key.

pull_requests.reviews.update.title: Update Pull Request Review
pull_requests.reviews.update.description: Update a pending pull request review summary via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews/{review_id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via pull_requests.reviews.get. 422 means the review is not pending: stop, do not retry.

body.description: The body text of the pull request review.

repos.merges.title: Merge a Branch
repos.merges.description: Merge a branch via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/merges. EffectPolicy Idempotent. Reconcile observes via repos.compare. 201 is the merge commit. A repeat after 201 is 204, not a second commit. Do not retry 409. This is not pull_requests.merge.

base.description: Base branch that the head will be merged into.

head.description: Head to merge. Branch name or commit SHA.

commitMessage.description: Commit message for the merge commit. Omitted when unset.

created.description: False when GitHub returns 204 because the branch was already merged.

branches.rename.title: Rename a Branch
branches.rename.description: Rename a branch via POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/rename. One-shot: no EffectPolicy. A second POST on the old name is 404, not a no-op. The handler reads branches.get of the new name only. That read is not a reconcile key.

branch.description: Current branch name.

repos.codeowners.errors.list.title: List CODEOWNERS Errors
repos.codeowners.errors.list.description: List CODEOWNERS syntax errors via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/codeowners/errors. The response object is errors, not a bare array.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit used to choose the CODEOWNERS file. Defaults to the repository default branch.

dependency_graph.compare.title: Compare Dependency Graph
dependency_graph.compare.description: Diff dependency changes between two commits via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependency-graph/compare/{basehead}. basehead is {base}...{head}. This is not repos.compare.

name.description: Full path, relative to the repository root, of the dependency manifest file.

code_scanning.alerts.instances.list.title: List Code Scanning Alert Instances
code_scanning.alerts.instances.list.description: List instances of a code scanning alert via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/alerts/{alert_number}/instances.

ref.description: Git reference for the instances to list.

pr.description: Pull request number for the instances to list.

code_scanning.analyses.list.title: List Code Scanning Analyses
code_scanning.analyses.list.description: List code scanning analyses via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/analyses. tool_name on this list response is closing down. Each analysis keeps the tool object. tool_name is not the identity.

toolName.description: Filter by code scanning tool name. Query only. Not the analysis identity.

toolGuid.description: Filter by code scanning tool GUID. Not both toolName and toolGuid.

pr.description: Pull request number for the analyses to list.

ref.description: Git reference for the analyses to list.

sarifId.description: Filter analyses belonging to the same SARIF upload.

code_scanning.analyses.get.title: Get Code Scanning Analysis
code_scanning.analyses.get.description: Get one code scanning analysis via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/analyses/{analysis_id}. Identity is analysis_id. The tool object is kept.

deployments.statuses.get.title: Get Deployment Status
deployments.statuses.get.description: Get one deployment status via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments/{deployment_id}/statuses/{status_id}.

checks.runs.list_for_suite.title: List Check Runs For Suite
checks.runs.list_for_suite.description: List check runs in a check suite via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-suites/{check_suite_id}/check-runs. This is not checks.runs.list_for_ref.

repos.autolinks.get.title: Get Autolink Reference
repos.autolinks.get.description: Get one repository autolink reference via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks/{autolink_id}. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

repos.readme.get.title: Get Repository README
repos.readme.get.description: Get the preferred repository README via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/readme. Read only. No effect meta. Optional ref selects the commitish. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

ref.description: The name of the commit, branch, or tag to get the README from.

repos.readme.get_for_dir.title: Get Directory README
repos.readme.get_for_dir.description: Get the preferred README for a directory via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/readme/{dir}. Read only. No effect meta. Directory segments are URL-encoded the same way as repos.contents.get. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

dir.description: Relative directory that may contain slash-separated segments.

ref.description: The name of the commit, branch, or tag.

repos.subscription.get.title: Get Repository Subscription
repos.subscription.get.description: Get the authenticated user's subscription to a repository via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/subscription. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

repos.community.profile.get.title: Get Community Profile Metrics
repos.community.profile.get.description: Get community profile metrics via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/community/profile. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

repos.interaction_limits.get.title: Get Repository Interaction Limits
repos.interaction_limits.get.description: Get interaction limits via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/interaction-limits. Read only. No effect meta. A 204 means no limits are set. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

repos.security_advisories.get.title: Get Repository Security Advisory
repos.security_advisories.get.description: Get one repository security advisory via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/security-advisories/{ghsa_id}. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

repos.license.get.title: Get Repository License
repos.license.get.description: Get the repository license contents via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/license. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

orgs.attestations.repositories.list.title: List Organization Attestation Repositories
orgs.attestations.repositories.list.description: List repositories with attestations via GET /orgs/{org}/attestations/repositories. Read only. No effect meta. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

org.description: Organization login.

users.events.public.list.title: List Public Events for a User
users.events.public.list.description: List public events for a user via GET /users/{username}/events/public. Read only. per_page max is 100 (default 30). The public timeline includes at most 300 events from the past 30 days. Accept is application/vnd.github+json. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

username.description: GitHub username (login). URL-encoded in the path.

users.received_events.public.list.title: List Public Events Received by a User
users.received_events.public.list.description: List public events received by a user via GET /users/{username}/received_events/public. Read only. per_page max is 100 (default 30). The timeline includes at most 300 events from the past 30 days. Accept is application/vnd.github+json. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

username.description: GitHub username (login). URL-encoded in the path.

users.keys.list.title: List Public SSH Keys for a User
users.keys.list.description: List public SSH keys for a user via GET /users/{username}/keys. Read only. Returns public key material, never private keys. per_page max is 100. Accept is application/vnd.github+json. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

username.description: GitHub username (login). URL-encoded in the path.

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List users via GET /users. Pagination uses since and per_page. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

since.description: User id cursor. Official query parameter since. Only users with a greater id are returned.

perPage.description: Results per page. Official query parameter per_page. Integer from 1 to 100.

users.starred.list.title: List Repositories Starred by a User
users.starred.list.description: List repositories starred by a user via GET /users/{username}/starred. Read only. Returns public stars as repository objects (Accept application/vnd.github+json, not the star media type). sort is created or updated; direction is asc or desc. per_page max is 100. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

repo.description: Repository name. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

secretName.description: Secret name. URL-encoded in the path.

deleted.description: True when the secret was deleted.

actions.org_secrets.create_or_update.title: Create or update an organization Actions secret
actions.org_secrets.create_or_update.description: PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secret_name}. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 201 when creating and 204 when updating. Caller-supplied encryptedValue + keyId. visibility is all, private, or selected. selectedRepositoryIds is required when visibility is selected. Secret GETs are not observes. No effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Bearer auth only.

org.description: Organization login. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

secretName.description: Secret name. URL-encoded in the path.

keyId.description: Public key id used to seal encryptedValue. String key_id from the org public-key GET.

visibility.description: Which repositories can use the secret: all, private, or selected.

selectedRepositoryIds.description: Repository ids. Required when visibility is selected. Sent as selected_repository_ids.

upserted.description: True when the secret was created or updated.

org.description: Organization login.

actions.org_secrets.repositories.set.title: Set selected repositories for an organization Actions secret
actions.org_secrets.repositories.set.description: PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secret_name}/repositories. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 204. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Bearer auth only.

org.description: Organization login. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

secretName.description: Secret name. URL-encoded in the path.

selectedRepositoryIds.description: Repository ids that can access the secret. This replaces the selected list.

actions.org_secrets.repositories.add.title: Add a selected repository to an organization Actions secret
actions.org_secrets.repositories.add.description: PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/secrets/{secret_name}/repositories/{repository_id}. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 204. org.description: Organization login. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

secretName.description: Secret name. URL-encoded in the path.

added.description: True when the repository was added.

repos.environments.deployment_protection.title: Enable a custom deployment protection rule for an environment
repos.environments.deployment_protection.description: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/deployment_protection_rules. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 201 with the enabled rule. Creates a new id, so no effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Sibling repos.environments.deployment_protection_rules.delete. Bearer auth only.

owner.description: Repository owner. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

repo.description: Repository name. A single path segment. The name is not case sensitive.

integrationId.description: GitHub App integration id for the custom protection rule.

markdown.render_raw.title: Render a Markdown document as raw text/plain
markdown.render_raw.description: POST /markdown/raw. kind=action, sideEffect=read. Success is 200 HTML. Request body is text/plain (the Markdown text), not JSON. Persists nothing and is safe to retry. No effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. Sibling markdown.render. Bearer auth only.

text.description: Markdown text sent as the raw text/plain request body.

user.codespaces.get.title: Get a codespace for the authenticated user
user.codespaces.get.description: GET /user/codespaces/{codespace_name}. Returns one codespace. A 200 is the codespace. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Read only. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

codespaceName.description: Codespace name. A single path segment.

user.codespaces.update.title: Update a codespace for the authenticated user
user.codespaces.update.description: PATCH /user/codespaces/{codespace_name}. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 200 with the codespace. At least one of machine, displayName, recentFolders is required. user.codespaces.get is co-carded but is not an exact observe (PATCH machine is a string; GET returns a machine object). No effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Bearer auth only.

codespaceName.description: Codespace name. A single path segment.

machine.description: Machine name to transition to (for example standardLinux).

displayName.description: Display name for the codespace. Sent as display_name.

recentFolders.description: Recently opened folders. Sent as recent_folders.

user.emails.delete.title: Delete email addresses for the authenticated user
user.emails.delete.description: DELETE /user/emails. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 204. Body is {emails}. No effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR, not success. Bearer auth only.

emails.description: Email addresses to delete. At least one.

deleted.description: True when the emails were deleted.

emails.description: Emails that were requested for deletion.

user.email.visibility.set.title: Set primary email visibility for the authenticated user
user.email.visibility.set.description: PATCH /user/email/visibility. kind=action, sideEffect=write. Success is 200 with the email list. One-shot; no exact observe GET on tip. No effectPolicy, no reconcile, and no effect. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Bearer auth only.

user.memberships.orgs.list.title: List organization memberships for the authenticated user
user.memberships.orgs.list.description: GET /user/memberships/orgs. Lists organization memberships for the authenticated user. Optional state filter active|pending. A 200 is the memberships array. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR. Read only. No effectPolicy and no reconcile.

orgs.actions.runners.labels.add.title: Add labels to an organization self-hosted runner

repos.actions.runners.labels.add.title: Add labels to a repository self-hosted runner

repos.actions.runners.jitconfig.create.title: Create a just-in-time configuration for a repository runner

actions.permissions.access.get.title: Get workflow access to a repository

actions.permissions.access.set.title: Set workflow access to a repository
actions.permissions.access.set.description: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions/access. Sets access_level. Reconcile via actions.permissions.access.get (exact observe; co-carded). Success is 204. A 404 is CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_ERROR.

accessLevel.description: Workflow access level. Sent as access_level.
